capabilities: Register local vault folders, including paths outside the current vault, as read-only retrieval sources
Index and search notes locally with BM25 and Chinese bigram lexical retrieval
Extract coding rules and generate sourced project-spec briefs with character budgets
Expose six MCP tools, an HTTP API, and a browser panel to AI clients
Track queries and cited fragments in a local citation ledger
extras: Much of the README is in Chinese. Desktop only. The 0.2.10 community-review status was unverified at publication; tokens are stored in plaintext in data.json and the exported connection config. The plugin was previously named Obsidian Quote and still uses that brand for its client integrations.
problem: AI coding assistants have no built-in way to pull context and coding rules from the user's own local notes while writing code.

relations.evidence: DeepSeek Harness provides its own sidebar, Codex has a settings panel where supported
Codex 桌面版 提供本项目的设置按钮与弹出检索面板
Claude Code、Codex CLI 主要通过六个 MCP 工具和对话返回结果

requires.name: Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, or another local MCP client

summary: Local service that registers Obsidian vaults as read-only reference sources for AI coding tools, serving cited snippets, rules, and briefs via MCP and HTTP.
